# toNumberFormat

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Resolves a [`NumberFormatInput`](number-format-input.md) to the [`NumberFormat`](number-format.md) value. A value that is already an enumeration value is returned unchanged.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
toNumberFormat(input: NumberFormatToken | NumberFormat): NumberFormat
```
